milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brick pillar is at spawn-relative (3, 2, 5) on the west interior wall. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually navigated into or near the workshop rather than triggering from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the pillar.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray wall banner is at spawn-relative (7, 2, 7) on the east interior wall facing west. max_distance=5 ensures intentional navigation to the banner area near the supply chest.

Uses inventory_has because mining carpet drops the carpet item into the player's inventory. Light gray carpet breaks instantly by hand or any tool and always drops itself. The carpet is on the workshop floor at y=0.

Uses inventory_has because mining glazed terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block item into inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe which is sufficient. Glazed terracotta is on the front/back walls at y=3 level.
Uses inventory_has because mining red nether brick slab with a pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe. Slabs are on the ceiling at y=4.
Uses inventory_has because mining blue terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block item into inventory. The player has an iron pickaxe. Blue terracotta forms the side walls at x=3 and x=8.

Uses inventory_has because crafting end_stone_bricks (4 end_stone in 2x2 pattern → 4 end_stone_bricks) places the result in inventory. Scene provides 6 end_stone blocks giving 2 blocks margin beyond the 4 required for one craft.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_stained_glass (8 glass surrounding 1 white_dye in crafting table → 8 white_stained_glass) places the result in inventory. Chest provides 16 glass and 8 white_dye.

Uses inventory_has because crafting yellow_stained_glass (8 glass surrounding 1 yellow_dye in crafting table → 8 yellow_stained_glass) places the result in inventory. Chest provides remaining 8 glass and 8 yellow_dye.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='air' because building a cave means hollowing out solid stone. The check box (-7,0,-7) to (-4,3,-4) is entirely within the stone hillside (filled at x=-8 to -3, y=-1 to 5, z=-8 to -3). Requiring 27 air blocks ensures a minimum 3x3x3 walkable space has been carved, which constitutes a meaningful cave.
